title: Relevance AI alternatives, with checked prices | 50agents
description: Relevance AI alternatives for sales teams: Lindy for a rep's assistant, Gumloop for team AI agents, n8n to self-host, and 50agents to start free.
answer: Relevance AI retired its free plan and charges $80 per 1,000 extra actions, so if you want to start free, 50agents is free to start and Zapier has a free plan.
For one rep's AI assistant, Lindy fits better; for team AI agents with IT controls, Gumloop; and for AI agents whose data must stay in-house, n8n self-hosts.
ask: Set up an AI agent that finds my HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days every weekday at 9:00 and drafts a follow-up email for me to approve
lede: Relevance AI sells teams of specialist AI agents for prospecting, research and follow-up, wired into Salesforce, HubSpot and Gong.

entries.suits: Small sales teams who want specific jobs done, such as drafting follow-ups for quiet deals, or a leads app that a Closer AI agent works through.
entries.limit: There are no prebuilt sales AI agent teams, and no evaluations. Each AI agent is built from your words, and you judge its runs.

entries.suits: Reps who want their own assistant in Slack, iMessage and email, which waits for their OK before anything with outside impact.
entries.price: $50 in credits for 7 days. Team: from $29.99 a month per active user
entries.limit: Billed per active user from $29.99 a month, so every rep is a seat.

entries.suits: Rev ops teams who build AI agents once and share them, with control over which tools and models each person uses.
entries.price: No free plan. Pro: $37 a month (20,000 credits)
entries.limit: No free plan: a 14-day trial with a card, then $37 a month for 20,000 credits.

entries.suits: Teams with an engineer who want prospect data and AI agent runs on their own servers, with approvals on tool calls.
entries.price: No free cloud plan. Starter: €20 a month billed yearly (2.5K executions)
entries.limit: Nothing is ready-made for sales: you build the AI agent, its prompts and its CRM steps yourself.

entries.suits: Teams whose CRM, enrichment and outreach tools are spread across many apps. With 10,541+ apps, Zapier is likely to connect all of them.
entries.price: Free: 100 tasks a month. Professional: $19.99 a month billed yearly (750 tasks)
entries.limit: Zapier Agents are billed in activities and Zaps in tasks, and every action step is a task.

us: You are a small team with one or two clear jobs, not a sales floor that needs an AI workforce.
You want to start free, with no card.
You want a leads app and the AI agents that work it in one place.
them: You want a ready team of sales AI agents connected to Salesforce, HubSpot and Gong, not single AI agents you build.
You test AI agents before rolling them out, with evaluations on Enterprise.
Your reps approve drafts from Slack or Teams.

move.title: Write down each AI agent's job and tools
move.body: We found no AI agent export on Relevance AI's own pages, so record each AI agent's instructions, the tools it calls, and which steps need approval.

move.title: Pick the two that earn their keep
move.body: Most teams rely on one or two AI agents. Move those first; leave the experiments.

move.title: Rebuild with approvals kept
move.body: In 50agents, any email to a prospect waits for your yes in Needs you, so the approval step you had carries over without setting it up.

move.title: Cancel at the end of the period
move.body: Run both for a week on live deals, compare the drafts, then cancel.

faqs.q: Does Relevance AI have a free plan?
faqs.a: No. Its pricing docs say the Free plan is retired for new signups and existing accounts. Pro starts at $19 a month billed yearly.

faqs.q: What is the best Relevance AI alternative for a small sales team?
faqs.a: One that starts free and does one job well: 50agents for follow-ups and a leads app, or Lindy for a rep's own assistant.

faqs.q: How many integrations does Relevance AI have?
faqs.a: Relevance AI says 2,000+, and its directory lists 2,728. Zapier lists 10,541+ and 50agents works with 2,300+ through viaSocket.
